neighbours.label: the shared-property construction 'X have one thing in common' and 'have ... to offer': the noun or verb that introduces what several things share or possess as a trait; plain possession or description stays quiet
fire: The best teachers I had all have one thing in common: patience.
Despite their differences, the two cities have one thing in common.
All great soups have a few things in common, starting with good stock.
These old cars have one thing in common, and it is rust.
Successful founders tend to have one thing in common with each other.
The three suspects had one thing in common that the police missed.
Most popular apps have a few things in common, such as speed.
Our two dogs have only one thing in common: they love the beach.
quiet: The best teachers I had all lived in the same small village.
